metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 iCalendar CLI in `output/`.

Files:
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

Verified build from `/workspace/output` with:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

The executable is `output/build/ical` and supports:

```bash
ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>
ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>
```

    def test_calendar_image_display_values_comma_list(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 7986 §6.1 allows the DISPLAY parameter to carry multiple values
        (comma-separated): `DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL`. The entire DISPLAY string
        should be surfaced; we accept either the raw joined string or a semantic
        split (depending on harness preference)."""
        out = run_parse(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_calprops(
                "IMAGE;VALUE=URI;DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL;FMTTYPE=image/png:"
                "https://example.com/weather-cloudy.png\n"
            ),
            tmp_path,
        )
        images = _dict_list_field(_cal(out), "images")
        assert len(images) == 1
        display = cast(str, images[0].get("display") or "")

    def test_rrule_count_and_until_mutually_exclusive(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path

        """RFC 5545 §3.3.10: UNTIL and COUNT MUST NOT occur in the same

            "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5;UNTIL=20260401T000000Z\n"
